result.brief: 提出Koopman双线性潜动力学加非线性观测解码器的概率世界模型，用EKF/平滑做潜状态推断，支持不确定性感知MPPI控制。
result.reason: Proposes a structured probabilistic latent world model (Koopman-bilinear dynamics with EKF inference) for prediction and MPPI control under partial observation, a world-modeling contribution rather than a policy paper.
